almanactcm:cfg-focus-delay-c: How long you must hold a crouched look before the tracker's read resolves. 0 shows it instantly.
almanactcm:cfg-vignette-intensity-c: How dark the screen edges get while focusing. 0 turns the vignette off entirely.
almanactcm:cfg-vignette-reach-c: How far the darkening creeps inward. Lower is a tighter tunnel, higher hugs the edges.
almanactcm:cfg-blood-visibility-c: How much your hunting rank swings a wounded animal's blood trail around its stock look. Stock shows at Journeyman. 0 turns the rank effect off. Higher means a fainter trail for a novice and a richer one for a master.
almanactcm:cfg-blood-persistence-c: How much your hunting rank swings how long a blood trail lingers. Stock duration shows at Journeyman. 0 turns the rank effect off. Higher means a shorter-lived trail for a novice and a longer one for a master.
almanactcm:cfg-toasts-enabled-c: Float a small '+0.4 Mining' over the hotbar when practice lands. Off hides the toasts entirely; the Info-tab line and the Callings tab are unaffected.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-color-c: Text color as a hex code like #E8C36A. Accepts #RGB, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; an unreadable value falls back to the amber default.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-fontsize-c: Font size of the toast text, before GUI scaling.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-lifetime-c: How long a toast lives from spawn to fully faded.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-rise-c: How far the toast drifts upward over its lifetime, in interface pixels. 0 holds it still.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-merge-c: Gains in the same calling within this window fold into one toast whose number ticks up, instead of stacking new lines. Felling a tree is a burst; keep this above zero.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-max-c: Cap on simultaneous toasts. Overflow drops the oldest.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-offsety-c: Where the newest toast spawns, in interface pixels above the bottom edge. The default sits over the hotbar.
almanactcm:cfg-toast-technique-c: Append the technique to the calling name, like '+0.4 Mining (quarrying)'.

almanactcm:cfg-discovery-banners-c: The lore-style banner that fades in when a rank is attained or a named piece of knowledge is earned. Off silences the banner; chat lines and the almanac's own pages are unaffected.

almanactcm:cfg-banner-fontsize-c: Font size of the banner text, before GUI scaling.
almanactcm:cfg-banner-hold-c: How long the banner sits at full ink between its fade-in and fade-out. Queued banners wait their turn.
almanactcm:cfg-quest-toasts-c: The small parchment strip that ticks off a checklist line from the almanac's guides when your work closes it. Off silences the strip; the checklists in the book still fill in as normal.
